description: Kerala High Court directed Govt to halt payments in further deals of Fully Automated Traffic Enforcement System.
body_lead: Kerala High Court: In a petition by two Congress leaders primarily seeking stay on the implementation of fully Automated Traffic enforcement system for Safe Kerala by levying fine on the public, S.V.N. Bhatti, C.J. and Basant Balaji, JJ. directed the respondents not to make any payment under annuity until further orders of the Court.
